newTopics.name: Fuel prices and the Mepco stabilisation mechanism
newTopics.timing: Predictable (weekly price updates; bill under 'discusión inmediata')
newTopics.problem: Sixth consecutive rise in fuel prices (+$40 per litre from 12 Nov). Gasoline rose 4.5% in October's CPI, which put annual inflation at 4.5%. Cadem (8 Nov): fuel prices and unemployment are the issues people most want the government to solve. A national truckers' strike from 10 Nov demanded lower fuel prices, a cut in the specific fuel tax and in tolls; talks with the government on 10–11 Nov ended without agreement.
newTopics.politics: After the extended political committee on 9 Nov, the President announced a bill capping each rise at $20 per litre for 90 days, with 'discusión inmediata'. It was filed on 10 Nov and withdrawn on 11 Nov to be adjusted, as talks with striking truckers continued. Truckers' organisations remain mobilised; the large federations were weighing whether to join.
newTopics.policy: Executive bill to change Mepco; Hacienda considering fiscal savings to moderate rises. Bonuses for taxi drivers, school transport and artisanal fishers were extended in September.
newTopics.frames: 'Social urgency' (President) vs 'fuel is still cheap for the region' (Minister Mas).
newTopics.changed: New topic this week. Entered through the discovery net (coverage spike plus poll salience); the truckers' strike was added by the reviewer.

precedents.text: 32 truckers' strikes in 36 years, plus announced strikes. In 24 of the 29 with a known date, diesel prices had been rising beforehand.
2008: a strike over the diesel tax ended with the government agreeing to refund 80% of the specific tax that year and 100% from 2009.
2022: a week-long strike ended with an agreement on fuel-price stabilisation, transport rates and security.

stories.title: Fuel prices open a problem window
stories.text: A sixth straight price rise and a national truckers' strike pushed the problem stream to its strongest level. The President's $20 cap bill was filed and then withdrawn for changes, so politics sits one level lower.

stories.title: The pension-fund window is closing
stories.text: Fund E recovered 8.4% between 24 October and 11 November and attention fell. The compensation bill is still pending.

stories.title: Approval: two polls, two directions
stories.text: Cadem rose to 29%; Criteria fell to 24%, its lowest of the term, with disapproval at 67%.
